messages:
clare: FYI seeing TLS handshake spike in apac since ~02:00 UTC after cipher rotation. ~6% failures, clients get TLS alert 40. Can infra+sec investigate? @luke-oncall

grace: Noted. prod-obsv shows SNI errors to services behind keystore-v2. Pulling edge logs.

sec-bot: rotator-bot: cipher-profile rotation completed in apac at 2026-03-20T03:12:04Z; keystore rollout progressing.

raj: Did we change KMS RBAC recently in apac? We tightened some service roles last night.

infra-ana: Edge tail: "TLSHandshake alert=fatal desc=handshake_failure keystore=keystore-v2 kms_decrypt=DENIED principal=svc-keystore-writer@redwood". Looks like KMS decrypt denies.

clare: That would explain nodes trying new chains but unable to unwrap private keys. Likely concurrent RBAC change.

grace: Triage plan: 1) confirm KMS DENIED in audit logs; 2) try local decrypt with service creds; 3) if deny, restore decrypt role temporarily.

raj: Confirmed: IAM patch removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from svc-keystore-writer at 2026-03-20T02:58Z (PR infra #8123).

infra-ana: Applying hotfix: re-add decrypt role for svc-keystore-writer on apac keys for 1h.

sec-bot: iam-audit-bot: binding added roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> svc-keystore-writer@redwood on projects/redwood/locations/apac/keyRING/apac-keys at 2026-03-20T03:18:22Z by infra-ana.

prod-obsv: Handshake failure rate dropped from 6.2% to 0.6% within 3m of hotfix.

clare: Immediate mitigation worked. Follow-ups: add pre-rotation keystore decrypt healthcheck, make cache TTL configurable, RBAC change blackout window around rotator runs, and increase KMS audit retention. I'll own the postmortem.
